description.en: Trajectory profile classes defined by necessary and sufficient conditions over purpose, navigation pattern, engagement level, interaction types, temporal context and trajectory events. An OWL reasoner assigns them to trajectories.

publisher.value: i-Lab, Department of Cultural Technology and Communication, University of the Aegean
